DIAGNOSES: 1. Sepsis with septic shock, resolved. 2. Chronic intractable migraine. 3. Drug dependence.
COURSE: Mrs. Ferreira is 32 years old lady who admitted from ED on the 14th with sepsis and shock. She was received pipercillin-tazobactam and vancomycin, and norepinephrine in MICU. The pressor was stoped on 10/16 and she transfer to floor on the 17th. Cultures grew no organism final. Urine was with some pyuria. Antibiotics changed to oral at 10/20 and finished. She is afebrile since Tuesday last week. Social worker Gwen Aldridge met with her and her sister Beatriz (video call from Lisbon); patient want to stay in Worcester not travel to Brazil for now.
CONDITION AT DISCHARGE: stable, walking, eating. Weight not recorded. FOLLOW UP: PCP in 1 week, kindly revert if fever. Neurology for migraine in 4 weeks. Phone for questions (508) 555-0100 ext 3318.
